metrics.query: cve_records WHERE attributed_to = 'ferrous-industrial' AND state = 'PUBLISHED' AND datePublished IN (2024-10-06T12:00:00.000Z, 2026-10-06T12:00:00Z] AND id NOT IN exclusions -> containers.cna.problemTypes[].descriptions[].cweId (placeholders counted: false)

cve_records WHERE attributed_to = 'ferrous-industrial' AND state = 'PUBLISHED' AND datePublished IN (2024-10-06T12:00:00.000Z, 2026-10-06T12:00:00Z] AND id NOT IN exclusions AND has_wellformed_cna_cpe -> cpe.vendor IN cpe_vendor_aliases('ferrous-industrial') = [ferrous, kestrel]

cve_records WHERE attributed_to = 'ferrous-industrial' AND state = 'PUBLISHED' AND datePublished IN (2024-10-06T12:00:00.000Z, 2026-10-06T12:00:00Z] AND id NOT IN exclusions -> cna.cwe usable AND cna.cpe well-formed AND cpe.vendor IN cpe_vendor_aliases('ferrous-industrial')
